name: Rondai-2
description: Rondai-2 was a cosmopolitan planet of mild weather and mild landscapes, with rolling hills but no mountains. It was two days travel by hyperspace from Haven and less than a day from Coruscant. It was a planet for top-security, low-profile business meetings in the Ulta Center.
